title: Sell Mineral Rights in Nunn, CO
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Nunn, CO | Far North Weld Ranch Country
metaDescription: Own minerals near Nunn, CO close to the Wyoming line? We check far-north Weld County spacing units and production before quoting your interest.
heroLead: Nunn sits in far northern Weld County, close enough to the Wyoming line that this stretch of DJ Basin ranch country has always felt more remote than the dense pad development around Greeley.
intro: This is wide-open ranching and dryland farming country, and mineral ownership here usually traces to a family operation that's worked this ground for generations. Development around Nunn has come in waves rather than the continuous dense buildout seen closer to the Wattenberg core, so a Nunn-area interest's story really depends on the specific spacing unit it falls into.

sections.heading: Spacing units in lower-density ranch country
paragraphs: Wells near Nunn are more spread out than in the tightly packed pads around Kersey or Mead, but the underlying Niobrara and Codell formations are the same productive zones. Some units here have seen multiple horizontal wells drilled over the past decade; others remain thinner, with a single well or none at all.
Because ranch tracts here tend to be large, a single mineral interest can sometimes span multiple spacing units, which is something we sort out carefully using your legal description before quoting.

sections.heading: What we look for
paragraphs: COGCC well and unit records specific to your section, plus any lease or pooling filings through the Weld County clerk and recorder's office. If there's active production, we value against the actual decline trend; if the ground is undrilled, we price it as speculative acreage.

faqs.question: Is drilling as dense near Nunn as it is near Greeley?
faqs.answer: No, this part of far northern Weld County has seen less concentrated development, though the same productive formations extend up here.

faqs.question: Can my interest span more than one spacing unit?
faqs.answer: Yes, particularly with the larger ranch tracts common around Nunn. We map that out from your legal description before quoting.

faqs.question: How do I get a copy of my lease if I've lost it?
faqs.answer: The Weld County clerk and recorder's office keeps recorded leases and can help you locate it, or we can help point you in the right direction.

faqs.question: Are ranch-scale interests near Nunn harder to value than smaller tracts?
faqs.answer: Not harder, just a bit more involved, since we may need to confirm boundaries across several spacing units instead of one. We handle that mapping as part of every evaluation.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum size interest you'll evaluate?
faqs.answer: No, we'll look at any documented interest regardless of size, including small fractional shares split across multiple heirs of a ranch estate.
